<li>Networking between scholarship holders and alumni via the Stipnet communication platform</li>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Other general conditions</h2>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Applications are welcome from all disciplines, i.e. not only from the natural and engineering sciences but also from the social sciences, humanities, economics and law. Interdisciplinary environmental research is especially encouraged. </li>



<li>Promising applicants have an above-average degree and are highly motivated to contribute to the solution of current environmental problems in a goal-oriented manner or to promote sustainable development.</li>



<li>The complete application documents must be prepared in German; applicants must have a good command of German (at least level B2).</li>



<li>Stays abroad are possible as long as the doctoral studies take place mainly at the supervising institution in Germany.</li>



<li>Incomplete applications and applications received after the respective application deadline cannot be considered.</li>



<li>No more than one application per working group/scientific supervisor may be submitted per application round.</li>



<li>Doctoral fellowships support individuals but not institutions.</li>



<li>It is not permissible to focus on a larger set of topics (bundling of individual applications) that has not been coordinated with the DBU.</li>



<li>Rejection of a scholarship application will preclude reapplication.</li>
</ul>
